scripts_dir.label: Provider scripts folder
scripts_dir.description: Folder holding slack_inbox.py, gmail_imap.py, google_calendar_feed.py and deployment_status.py (the DMS scripts are reused in place).

secrets_dir.label: Secrets folder
secrets_dir.description: Folder with linear-api-key, gmail-address, gmail-app-password and google-calendar-ical-url (written by the configure-*.sh helpers).

python.label: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter used to run the Slack, Gmail and Deployments scripts.

show_breakdown.label: Per-provider chips
show_breakdown.description: Show one chip per provider (GH 3 · SL 5 …) instead of a single total; clicking a chip opens that provider.
